Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 716.38 crores and a profit after tax of INR 50.48 crores. The company successfully commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai, and is developing an upcoming facility in Jaipur with an allotted capex of around INR 47 crores. Management reiterated its guidance of reaching INR 3,500 crores in revenue for the current financial year, targeting 30% to 40% volume growth and 50% to 60% value growth. Furthermore, the board approved a rights issue of up to INR 100 crores to fund working capital and fuel future growth trajectories. Shanti Gold International Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27 and FY26, highlighting strong growth in revenue, profitability, and sales volume alongside ongoing manufacturing capacity expansions.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its top-line revenue guidance of INR 3,500 crores for the current year.
guidance.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth this year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin range of 7.5% to 8%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin would be around 7.5% to 8%.

guidance.claim: Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the sustainable PAT business margin is around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Management expects export contribution to go up from 10% to 20% or more.
guidance.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery market outlook remains constructive supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand.
demand_outlook.quote: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Organized jewellers and retailers have an increasing outsourcing preference due to expansion, inventory optimization, and faster design cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have commenced at the new Marol manufacturing facility in Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has allotted around INR 47 crores of capex for its Jaipur facility, expected to be operational around November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur plant spans 3 acres of land, with the initial 50,000 square feet facility representing the first phase.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a Dubai office to expand its international footprint and is awaiting RBI approval.
capex_expansion.quote: In that, I will just add up, because our Dubai factory has just – Dubai office is just coming in which have just done with the compliance patent laws, we are just – in back in India, we are awaiting for the RBI approval.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The Marol factory is expected to start in about a month, and the Jaipur factory is expected to start around September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: A change in inventory method from FIFO to WAC resulted in an inventory gain of 2% to 2.5% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: See, there was a change in inventory method from FIFO to WAC method. There was some unrealized gain which was locked in the inventory of last year, which got spilled in this current year.

margins_costs.claim: Adjusting for one-off inventory gains, sustainable EBITDA margin is expected to be in the 7.5% to 8% range.
margins_costs.quote: So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 PAT margins stood at 7.88% against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 PAT margins stood at 6.94% compared to 4.89% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% as compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis pointsY-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Bridal jewellery has a higher margin while plain gold has a lesser margin.
margins_costs.quote: Margin, so bridal jewellery has a higher margin and plain gold has a lesser margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility is 75%.
Existing manufacturing capacity is 2.7 tons, while the new Marol facility adds around 4 tons of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So after our new facility, Jaipur and everything which starts, so you know, we are manufacturing with now with the capacity of 2.7 ton and our new facility which has started with around 4 ton.

orders_capacity.claim: Designer jewellery accounts for 75% of revenue, while plain gold jewellery contributes 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: 75% of the revenue is from our designer jewellery and 25% from plain gold jewellery.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports accounted for 4% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: So as of now, the export part comprises of 4% of the total revenue for Q1.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an existing installed capacity of approximately 6,700 kg pa across Andheri and Marol.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue to raise up to INR 100 crores by issuing 46,43,471 equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The current debt-to-equity ratio is 0.50, and management plans to keep it under 1.0x.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Negative cash flow results from maintaining ready inventory stocks rather than operating on an order-to-order basis.
capital_allocation.quote: The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to weighted average cost (WAC) with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: Management aims for a maximum debt-to-equity ratio close to 1:1 to fuel future growth expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: To answer your question, maximum at this point if I say, we should be comfortable at going at 1:1. That's what we are aiming for now to fuel the future growth expansion.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted potential near-term short-term jitters in gold prices despite a bullish long-term outlook.
risks_headwinds.quote: So we are hopeful that the gold will, maybe there could be a short-term jitters in the near-term, but going forward in the long-term, we expect a good rally in the gold market, and we remain very bullish on that because the fundamentals remain very strong for the gold.

risks_headwinds.claim: Working capital requirements will increase to support business expansion and inventory buildup.
risks_headwinds.quote: So certainly the working capital needs will be there, and going ahead as we are coming also with new factory, new set up, new footprint in the offshore markets and all, so yes, from that percent, my inventory -- my working capital needs certainly will go up.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended to June '26 due to geopolitical issues and wars in the region.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve revenue of INR 3,500 crores in the current year.
management_commitments.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is planned to become operational around November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to creating sustainable long-term value.
management_commitments.quote: We deeply value your confidence in our journey and remain committed to creating sustainable long-term value.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains deeply committed to offering differentiated designs and superior product quality to contemporary designs.
management_commitments.quote: we remain deeply committed to offering differentiated designs and superior product quality to contemporary designs, while maintaining consistency in execution while continuing to drive repeat business and customer stickiness.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Jaipur factory to start by around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
